desc:
🏠 Welcome to Moving House Simulator!
❗Take on moving jobs solo or with friends and build your moving company from the ground up!
📦 Pack messy homes by sorting toys, clothes, kitchenware, electronics, decor, tools and more into the correct boxes.
🚚 Move furniture, load the truck, travel to the new home, and unpack everything where it belongs!
⭐ Complete jobs to earn XP and Mover Dollars, level up your company, unlock new maps, and buy van skins and garage decorations.
🏆 Beat your best times, earn perfect moves, complete achievements, take on daily jobs, and fill your garage with trophies!
❗Features:
• Solo and group moving jobs
• Company levels, XP and Mover Dollars
• Unlockable maps, van skins and garage decor
• Daily jobs and achievements
• Job ratings, best times and perfect moves
• Packing, loading, travelling and unpacking
😊 Grab a box, grow your company, and become the ultimate mover!
